cues: Nepal is going through an epidemiological transition: infections are retreating, and non communicable diseases now cause about two thirds of deaths.
Chronic lung disease from smoke, heart disease and stroke lead the list.
One adult in four has high blood pressure, and nearly three in ten use tobacco.
